_comment: Reusable RDL schema-compatibility registry. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for which RDL elements are valid in which schema version. This is a version registry, NOT an element blacklist: the validator compares each element's minimum schema version against the version detected from the document's root namespace. Extend `elementMinVersion` (and, if ever needed, `elementMaxVersion`) here instead of hardcoding element checks anywhere else.
_maintenance: When a new RDL element is discovered to be gated to a schema version, add one entry to `elementMinVersion` keyed by the element's local name. No code change is required.

elementMinVersion._note: Local element name -> minimum RDL schema version in which the element is valid. Elements NOT listed are treated as version-neutral (allowed in any recognized schema). Only list elements that are genuinely gated to a version.
